part: Tube splice: one U channel and two front bars that hold two pieces of the square tube end to end.
profile: Cross-section from enclosure.json (tube and clamp sections): the fit-tested U1 pocket (18.9 mm) with the M2.5 clearance holes, captured-nut slots and head recesses of US-NECK-MOUNT-R010.

notes.grip: Length of U that holds each tube piece; the tube ends meet at z = grip, the middle of the U. 30 mm is 1.5 times the neck clamp's 20 mm: the pocket's 0.3 to 0.9 mm of sideways play then lets a piece rock at most 0.6 to 1.7 degrees before the arms stop it, instead of 0.9 to 2.6.
notes.split_gap: Space between the two bars at the split, so each bar tightens on its own tube piece.
notes.row_inset: Each bar's two screw rows sit this far from its ends.
notes.screw: M2.5 socket-head screw length, checked against the clamp's screw window.
